ai.title: AI Summary
ai.pending: AI analysis is still in progress…
ai.rateLimited: AI analysis temporarily unavailable (rate limited) — retry in ~{seconds}s.
ai.notConfigured: AI analysis is not configured on this server.
ai.unsupportedStorage: AI analysis is only supported with local filesystem storage.

failure.auth: AI analysis failed: the Anthropic API key is invalid or revoked. An admin needs to update ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server.
failure.forbidden: AI analysis failed: the Anthropic API key has no access to this model. Check the key’s permissions or ANTHROPIC_MODEL.
failure.billing: AI analysis failed: the Anthropic account has run out of credits. Top up the balance, then press Generate.
failure.model: AI analysis failed: the configured model doesn’t exist. Check ANTHROPIC_MODEL on the server.
failure.rateLimit: AI analysis hit the Anthropic rate limit. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.unavailable: Anthropic is overloaded or temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
failure.network: The server couldn’t reach Anthropic (network or timeout). Try again later.
failure.badRequest: Anthropic rejected the request (for example, the report is too large for the model).
failure.readReport: AI analysis failed: the report files couldn’t be read.
failure.writeSummary: AI analysis finished but the summary couldn’t be saved.
failure.emptyResponse: Anthropic returned an empty answer. Try generating again.
failure.unknown: AI analysis failed with an unexpected error.
